title: Russia claims cyberattacks on voting system, Putin accuses Ukraine of election interference
content_md:
Russia claims cyberattacks on voting system, Putin accuses Ukraine of election interference

Russia reported cyberattacks on its electronic voting system during the second day of parliamentary elections. President Putin accused Ukraine of attempting to interfere with the elections. The claims were reported by Romanian outlet wp.me.

via https://wp.me/p9KpFA-5xgz
